name: Total Charges 8
definition: Specifies the total amount of records and charges included in the block.

NumberOfChargesBreakdownItems.name: Number Of Charges Breakdown Items
NumberOfChargesBreakdownItems.definition: Number of individual charges breakdown items contained in the record.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual charges breakdown amounts, irrespective of currencies.

TotalChargesAmount.name: Total Charges Amount
TotalChargesAmount.definition: Total amount of charges claimed through the charges breakdown items.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the total charges amount is a credit or a debit amount. |Usage: A zero amount is considered to be a credit.
